prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Automatised cloud service for video file processing
Automatised cloud service that merges 4 individual incoming video sources/streams to one seamless splitscreen file output (quad split). Live and VOD. The solution must also handle the synch of the incoming video files and especially separate audios. input: 4x HD (or lower) 16:9 output: 1x 4K (or lower) 16:9 Handling of a bunch of current standard codecs +. user generated content / mobile devices to eliminate transcoding beforehand. The end result must be a barrier free, cloud based and automatised “transformer”. Barrier free on the perspective of the content creator to hand over the 4 sources. Barrier free on perspective of the editor to get a readymade quad split file. I want to optimise editing processes.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Charity admin modernisation
client: Oakfield Charities
client_industry: nonprofit
start: 2022-10
end: 2023-01
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Django
- PostgreSQL
- HTMX
- Celery
built: Upgraded a Django 1.11 donor system to Django 4.1 and rebuilt the donation
  entry screens with HTMX.
metrics:
- donation entry time down 45%
- zero data loss across 180k donor records

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Charity admin modernisation (p08).
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working developer with 7 years of experience building reliable web applications, and I’d love to help with your automated cloud service for video file processing.

Your project is exactly the kind of systems-focused work I enjoy: a barrier-free, cloud-based workflow that takes 4 incoming video sources, synchronises them properly, and outputs a seamless quad-split file for both live and VOD use. I understand the importance of making the process simple for content creators while also giving editors a ready-made result that reduces manual effort and speeds up the editing pipeline.

My background includes extensive experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack development, HTML, and CSS. That combination gives me a strong foundation for building the kind of user-facing and backend workflow your service needs: intake handling, orchestration, file processing logic, and a clean interface for managing the whole process. I’m also comfortable working on systems where reliability, data handling, and automation matter.

One project I can point to is my work on Charity admin modernisation for Oakfield Charities. I upgraded a Django 1.11 donor system to Django 4.1 and rebuilt the donation entry screens with HTMX. The result was donation entry time down 45% and zero data loss across 180k donor records. That project required careful handling of existing data, process improvement, and a practical approach to modernising a workflow without disruption — all of which are relevant to a production-grade media automation system.

For your video processing service, I’d approach the build with a strong focus on robust workflow design, clean API structure, and a user experience that makes source handoff and output retrieval as simple as possible. I’d also prioritize maintainability so the system can evolve as codec requirements, input formats, and workflow needs change.

If you’re looking for someone who can think both technically and operationally about the full workflow, I’d be glad to discuss how I can help bring this transformer service to life.
